description: This file implements the RpcTransport and RpcTransportCtx classes for Trusty TIPC communication, including message sending, receiving, and handling of ancillary file descriptors, within the Android project.

classes.name: RpcTransportTipcTrusty
classes.description: Handles TIPC message transport over a trusty socket, including reading, writing, and message management.

classes.name: RpcTransportCtxTipcTrusty
classes.description: Factory class for creating RpcTransport instances and managing certificates for Trusty TIPC.

methods.name: pollRead
methods.description: Checks if there is a message to read from the socket.

methods.name: interruptableWriteFully
methods.description: Sends data over the socket, handling ancillary file descriptors and retries if the peer is blocked.

methods.name: interruptableReadFully
methods.description: Reads data from the socket, handling message boundaries and ancillary file descriptors.

methods.name: isWaiting
methods.description: Returns whether the socket is in a polling state.

methods.name: ensureMessage
methods.description: Ensures a message is available for reading, optionally waiting.

methods.name: releaseMessage
methods.description: Releases the current message, freeing resources.

methods.name: newTransport
methods.description: Creates a new RpcTransport instance for a given socket.

methods.name: getCertificate
methods.description: Returns an empty certificate (not used in this implementation).

methods.name: newServerCtx
methods.description: Creates a new server context for Trusty TIPC.

methods.name: newClientCtx
methods.description: Creates a new client context for Trusty TIPC.

methods.name: toCString
methods.description: Returns the string 'trusty' representing the context type.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Creates a new factory instance for Trusty TIPC contexts.
